digest.component_or_area: Release automation and packaging (0.12.0 minor release)
propositions: Cut rebar 0.12.0 minor release from reviewed main, updating version lockstep across pyproject.toml, server.json (top-level and packages[]), and uv.lock.

CHANGELOG.md curated [Unreleased] must be retitled to [0.12.0] - 2026-08-15 with fresh [Unreleased] section and updated compare links; pre-existing duplicate [Unreleased] header defect must be merged.

Release preflight guards (version-lockstep, lint, typecheck, full test suite, build, twine check) must all pass; Gerrit review must obtain LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with zero unresolved comments before submit to main.

Dispatch release.yml from main with version=0.12.0, obtain required pypi environment approval, and verify all 10 workflow jobs succeed; post-publication verify PyPI service, PEP 740 attestation, GitHub tag/release, MCP Registry, and Homebrew tap.
Channel install nava-rebar[mcp]==0.12.0 and run packaged probe (scripts/probe_rebar.py) with zero failures; record all receipts and verify rollback disposition.
